description: Go module groups, moved out of the golang overlay so they no longer depend on where that overlay sits in an extends list. Inert in a repository without go.mod, and the indirect group is inert until the golang overlay enables indirect modules.

packageRules.description: Indirect Go modules share one branch. The golang overlay enables them; this rule only decides where they land.

golang.org/x modules share one branch whether they are direct or indirect. They cut releases in lockstep, share go.sum entries, and `go mod tidy` resolves them together, so one pull request per module only rebases the others for no review value.
